plugins.name: skill-review
plugins.description: Quick AI reviewer for Agent Skills: checks structure, workflow, references, and links. Clear report without jargon, with a summary from an exhausted data scientist.

plugins.name: filters
plugins.description: Build, edit and explain CDP filters. filter-build turns a description of an audience into a platform-confirmed filter, with a link when one is available or JSON when another tool needs it. filter-explain turns filter JSON back into a business description of its conditions, its limits and anything that could not be interpreted. Nothing is saved as a segment and no project data is changed.
